title: Comment on status hero-exit-threaded "Hero fade-out on Safari's scroll thread (GPU, identical)": What's the problem ?

anchor.quote: does not match: Progress hero-exit-threaded: in best build (v7); status row: being diagnosed (status.mjs sync sets it done)
anchor.label: Hero fade-out on Safari's scroll thread (GPU, identical)

messages.text:
The problem was a mix-up of two jobs on one row. It is fixed now.

- The hero fade-out fix landed and is in the best build (v7). The board's red line said the row disagreed with that.
- The owner had reused the same row for a new job: the end-of-page menu (PR-018 rev 7), "being diagnosed". So the row told two stories.
- I gave the new job its own row, pr-018-menu-morph, and set the hero row to done. The board check is now clean.
- Cause: a follow-up job on a landed fix. The long-term fix is a tool rule that refuses it, with ts-board.

What you need to do: nothing.
